title: Look-Back Span for Reading the Interface Style of Branch Customers — PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** When the interface style in use is read from an enrollment's lines in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, the span read back from the handling day is:

- **three calendar months** for a patient who collected four or more self-pay lines at a branch in the last 6 months;
- **two calendar months** for one who collected two or three.

A patient who collected fewer than two self-pay lines at a branch in the last 6 months receives no widened span under this rule.

## Counting

Self-pay lines collected at a branch are lines paid by the patient and picked up at a Summit Ridge branch, of any item. A line is in the last 6 months when its ship date is fewer than 6 whole calendar months before the handling day. A span of N calendar months covers lines whose ship date is fewer than N whole calendar months before the handling day.

| Branch-collected self-pay lines in the last 6 months | Span read back |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 3 calendar months |
| 2 or 3 | 2 calendar months |
| 0 or 1 | no widened span |

## Cases (hypothetical, handling day 20 May)

- Five branch-collected self-pay lines since December: span of three calendar months, reaching lines shipped from 21 February.
- Three such lines: span of two calendar months, reaching lines shipped from 21 March.
- One such line: no widened span.
